**Autonomy:** Human-driven (agent-assisted) - or - Fully autonomous

**Agents:** each agent that wrote or reviewed the change, with its tool and model, e.g. `layer-builder` (Claude Code, Opus 5.5)

**Extent:** what agents did (idea, design, code, tests, review) and what a person did
